flea-market.titleTr: Vintage Treasure and Bargaining at the Flea Market
flea-market.description: On a sunny weekend, explore Marco's vintage stall at the European flea market, ask about the history of a 1970s mechanical camera, bargain politely, and make a cash deal.
flea-market.situation: Discover a unique piece at a nostalgic antique stall in a lively outdoor flea market like Portobello / Mauerpark and negotiate the price with the seller.
flea-market.objectives.0.textTr: Ask if the vintage item is still functional and learn its backstory.
flea-market.objectives.0.hint: Template: "Is this camera still functional, or is it decorative?"
flea-market.objectives.1.textTr: Politely negotiate the price within your travel budget.
flea-market.objectives.1.hint: Template: "That is a bit above my budget. Would you be willing to do seventy?"
flea-market.objectives.2.textTr: Inquire about maintenance/film and conclude the cash purchase.
flea-market.objectives.2.hint: Template: "Does it require any special film? I will take it for seventy-five."
flea-market.keyPhrases.0.tr: Is this vintage camera still fully functional or purely decorative?
flea-market.keyPhrases.1.tr: That is a bit above my budget, would you consider seventy euros?
flea-market.keyPhrases.2.tr: Seventy-five euros sounds very fair, I will pay in cash.
flea-market.videoSteps.0.title: Interest in the Stall & Is it Functional?
flea-market.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Welcome to the flea market! Take your time looking around. That vintage mechanical camera in your hands is a true classic from the nineteen-seventies.
flea-market.videoSteps.0.userHint: Hello! It caught my eye. Is this camera still fully functional? (Hâlâ çalışıyor mu?) diye sor.
flea-market.videoSteps.1.title: Working Condition & Area of Interest
flea-market.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: It is in working condition! The lens is clear and the shutter clicks smoothly. Are you an analog photography lover or looking for a special souvenir?
flea-market.videoSteps.1.userHint: I love analog photography! I have been searching for a classic camera (Analog fotoğrafı çok severim, seyahatlerim için klasik bir makine arıyorum) de.
flea-market.videoSteps.2.title: Camera's History & Price Tag
flea-market.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: I actually discovered it in Vienna last month. It comes with its genuine leather strap and lens cap. The tag price is eighty-five euros.
flea-market.videoSteps.2.userHint: It has a wonderful history! That is a bit above my budget. Would you do seventy euros? (70 euro olur mu?) diye pazarlık yap.
flea-market.videoSteps.3.title: Polite Bargaining & Counter Offer
flea-market.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: You drive a hard bargain, my friend! The lowest I could do is seventy-five euros if you can pay in cash today. How does that sound?
flea-market.videoSteps.3.userHint: Seventy-five euros sounds very fair to me. Does it require special film? (75 euro çok makul. Özel bir film gerekir mi?) diye sor.
flea-market.videoSteps.4.title: Film Type & Usage Tips
flea-market.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: It takes standard thirty-five millimeter film, easily available in any photo shop. Just keep it dry and it will last another lifetime.
flea-market.videoSteps.4.userHint: That is great advice! I will definitely take it. Here is seventy-five euros in cash (Alıyorum, buyrun 75 euro nakit) diyerek parayı uzat.
flea-market.videoSteps.5.title: Packaging & Farewell
flea-market.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Thank you very much! Here is your camera, carefully wrapped. I hope you capture unforgettable memories on your journey!
flea-market.videoSteps.5.userHint: Thank you so much for your warmth and great deal, Marco! (Sıcaklığınız ve güzel indirim için teşekkürler Marco!) diyerek vedalaş.

local-sim-card.titleTr: Local SIM / eSIM Acquisition and Internet Package
local-sim-card.description: Meet Leo at the TeleConnect store, choose a suitable eSIM/SIM package for your trip, learn about roaming conditions across Europe, and online top-up.
local-sim-card.situation: You can buy a prepaid internet line at the mobile communication store at the airport for your trip to Europe.
local-sim-card.objectives.0.textTr: Request an eSIM or prepaid data SIM for your trip.
local-sim-card.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "I need a prepaid data SIM or eSIM for my phone."
local-sim-card.objectives.1.textTr: Inquire about gigabytes and European roaming coverage.
local-sim-card.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "Does this plan include free roaming in neighboring countries?"
local-sim-card.objectives.2.textTr: Ask how to top up data online and complete the purchase.
local-sim-card.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "Can I top up data online through your app?"
local-sim-card.keyPhrases.0.tr: I need a prepaid data SIM or eSIM for my phone.
local-sim-card.keyPhrases.1.tr: Does this plan include free roaming if I travel to neighboring countries?
local-sim-card.keyPhrases.2.tr: Can I easily top up more data online through your mobile app?
local-sim-card.videoSteps.0.title: Store Greeting & Prepaid Line Request
local-sim-card.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Welcome to TeleConnect! How can I help you stay connected today?
local-sim-card.videoSteps.0.userHint: Hello! I need a prepaid data SIM or eSIM for my phone (I want a prepaid internet package) too.
local-sim-card.videoSteps.1.title: eSIM Compatibility & Data Amount
local-sim-card.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: We offer both! An eSIM activates digitally in just a few seconds. Is your device eSIM-compatible?
local-sim-card.videoSteps.1.userHint: Yes, my phone supports eSIM. How many gigabytes of data are included? ask.
local-sim-card.videoSteps.2.title: Tourist Package & Roaming Coverage
local-sim-card.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Our tourist package comes with thirty gigabytes of data. Does that sound like enough for your trip?
local-sim-card.videoSteps.2.userHint: Thirty gigabytes is plenty! Does this include free roaming? ask.
local-sim-card.videoSteps.3.title: Roaming Approval & Online Top Up
local-sim-card.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: Yes, full European roaming is included at no extra cost! It also comes with two hundred local calling minutes.
local-sim-card.videoSteps.3.userHint: Can I easily top up more data online through your app? ask.
local-sim-card.videoSteps.4.title: Passport Registration & Amount
local-sim-card.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Yes, you can top up anytime in the app! The package is twenty-five euros. May I scan your passport for the registration?
local-sim-card.videoSteps.4.userHint: Sure thing! Here is my passport and credit card extending my documents.
local-sim-card.videoSteps.5.title: Activation Card Delivery & Connection
local-sim-card.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Here is your digital activation card. Just follow the setup prompt in your settings to connect. Enjoy your stay!
local-sim-card.videoSteps.5.userHint: It just connected to the network, fantastic! Thank you Leo! saying thank you.

rooftop-social.titleTr: Meeting at the Terrace Bar and Travel Chat
rooftop-social.description: Meet Australian traveler Chloe at a terrace lounge with a view at sunset, share your travel routes, discuss cultural differences, and make plans for tomorrow's city tour.
rooftop-social.situation: You start a conversation with traveler Chloe at the next table while watching the sunset from a hostel terrace in Europe.
rooftop-social.objectives.0.textTr: Comment on the sunset view and introduce your travel timeline.
rooftop-social.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "The sunset is breathtaking. I arrived three days ago."
rooftop-social.objectives.1.textTr: Discuss cultural differences you noticed in the city.
rooftop-social.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "People eat dinner much later than in my country."
rooftop-social.objectives.2.textTr: Accept the invitation for the walking tour and swap social handles.
rooftop-social.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "I would definitely love that! Let's meet at nine-thirty."
rooftop-social.keyPhrases.0.tr: The sunset over the city is absolutely breathtaking.
rooftop-social.keyPhrases.1.tr: People here eat dinner much later than in my country.
rooftop-social.keyPhrases.2.tr: Walking around the castle district sounds like a wonderful adventure.
rooftop-social.videoSteps.0.title: Meeting at the Terrace Lounge & Sunset
rooftop-social.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Hi there! Feel free to grab that chair, nobody is sitting here. Amazing view of the sunset, isn't it?
rooftop-social.videoSteps.0.userHint: Thank you so much! Yes, the sunset over the city is breathtaking (Manzara nefes kesici) diyerek otur.
rooftop-social.videoSteps.1.title: Meeting & How Long Have You Been Traveling?
rooftop-social.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: I'm Chloe, by the way! I have been backpacking across Europe for three weeks now. How long have you been in town?
rooftop-social.videoSteps.1.userHint: Nice to meet you Chloe! I arrived three days ago... (3 gün önce geldim, 1 hafta daha buradayım) de.
rooftop-social.videoSteps.2.title: Culture Shock & Differences
rooftop-social.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: A week is plenty of time! Have you noticed any funny cultural differences or surprises since you arrived?
rooftop-social.videoSteps.2.userHint: People here eat dinner much later... (Burada akşam yemeği çok daha geç yeniyor, geceleri herkes çok enerjik) diyerek anlat.
rooftop-social.videoSteps.3.title: Hidden Spots & City Recommendations
rooftop-social.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: Haha, that is so true! I discovered a hidden local bakery in the old town this morning. What places are you planning to see?
rooftop-social.videoSteps.3.userHint: Could you recommend the best historical spots or museums? (Bana tarihi yer veya müze önerir misin?) diye sor.
rooftop-social.videoSteps.4.title: Proposal to Explore the Castle Area Together
rooftop-social.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: I'm actually doing a walking tour of the historic castle district tomorrow at ten. Would you like to join me?
rooftop-social.videoSteps.4.userHint: I would definitely love that! (Kesinlikle çok isterim, harika bir macera olur) diyerek teklifi kabul et.
rooftop-social.videoSteps.5.title: Sharing Contact Information & Agreement
rooftop-social.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Brilliant! Let's swap social handles so we can coordinate in the morning. Cheers to new adventures!
rooftop-social.videoSteps.5.userHint: Here is my handle! Let's meet at the lobby at nine-thirty. Cheers! diyerek sözleş ve kadeh kaldır.

apartment-viewing.titleTr: Rental Apartment Review and Contract Terms
apartment-viewing.description: Meet the landlord David while touring a rental apartment in Europe, negotiating bills, deposit, public transport, and moving date.
apartment-viewing.situation: While touring a rental loft apartment in Europe, you discuss the terms with the landlord David and set the moving date.
apartment-viewing.objectives.0.textTr: Compliment the apartment and ask about utility bills.
apartment-viewing.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "The living room looks spacious. Are utilities included in the rent?"
apartment-viewing.objectives.1.textTr: Inquire about security deposit and lease length.
apartment-viewing.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "How much is the security deposit, and is it refundable?"
apartment-viewing.objectives.2.textTr: Propose a move-in date and agree on application steps.
apartment-viewing.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "I would love to move in by the first of next month."
apartment-viewing.keyPhrases.0.tr: The living room looks very spacious and bright.
apartment-viewing.keyPhrases.1.tr: Are water, electricity, and high-speed internet included?
apartment-viewing.keyPhrases.2.tr: I will send over my documents this evening.
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.0.title: Welcoming at the Apartment Entrance & First Impression
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Hello! Welcome to the apartment. Come on in! As you can see, it gets plenty of natural sunlight.
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.0.userHint: Hello David! The living room looks very spacious and bright diyerek daireyi öv.
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.1.title: Rent & Utility Bills
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: I am glad you like it! The monthly rent is twelve hundred euros. Were you wondering about the utility bills?
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.1.userHint: Are water, electricity, and internet included in the rent?
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.2.title: Deposit & Contract Duration
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Water and heating are included, but electricity and Wi-Fi are separate. We usually ask for a one-year lease.
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.2.userHint: How much is the deposit, and is it refundable?
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.3.title: Public Transport & Neighborhood Information
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: The deposit is two months' rent, and you get it back when you move out. How do you like the neighborhood?
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.3.userHint: The location is fantastic! How far is the nearest metro station?
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.4.title: Furniture Condition & Move-in Date
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: The metro is just a three-minute walk! The flat comes fully furnished as seen. When would you like to move in?
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.4.userHint: I would love to move in by the first of next month...
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.5.title: Application Documents & Contract
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: The first of the month is perfect! Just email me your proof of income, and I will draft the tenancy agreement.
apartment-viewing.videoSteps.5.userHint: I will send over my documents this evening. Thank you David!

colleague-break.titleTr: Office Coffee Break and Weekend Chat
colleague-break.description: Meet your coworker Maya while getting coffee in the office kitchen, talk about how the weekend went, discuss the project meeting, and make plans for lunch.
colleague-break.situation: On Monday morning, while getting coffee in the office kitchen, you chat with your coworker Maya about the weekend and lunch.
colleague-break.objectives.0.textTr: Share your weekend activities using the past tense.
colleague-break.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "I watched a great movie and went for a bike ride."
colleague-break.objectives.1.textTr: Discuss the upcoming meeting and presentation slides.
colleague-break.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "Almost ready! I finished my slides."
colleague-break.objectives.2.textTr: Suggest a lunch spot and agree on a time.
colleague-break.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "Let's try that new taco place. Sounds like a plan!"
colleague-break.keyPhrases.0.tr: It was really relaxing, thank you. How was yours?
colleague-break.keyPhrases.1.tr: I finished my slides, but I need to review them.
colleague-break.keyPhrases.2.tr: Sounds like a plan! See you at eleven.
colleague-break.videoSteps.0.title: Coffee Machine Greetings & Weekend Opening
colleague-break.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Hey! Good morning! Monday arrived so fast. How was your weekend?
colleague-break.videoSteps.0.userHint: Good morning Maya! It was really relaxing... How was yours?
colleague-break.videoSteps.1.title: Weekend Activities (Past Tense)
colleague-break.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: Mine was great! I visited an outdoor food festival with my friends. Did you do anything fun?
colleague-break.videoSteps.1.userHint: Yes, I watched a movie and went for a bike ride.
colleague-break.videoSteps.2.title: Movie Details & Mutual Interest
colleague-break.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: That sounds so peaceful! Which movie did you watch? Was it any good?
colleague-break.videoSteps.2.userHint: It was a new sci-fi film... The effects were amazing.
colleague-break.videoSteps.3.title: Workload & Team Meeting
colleague-break.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: I definitely need to watch that! Are you ready for our team standup meeting at eleven?
colleague-break.videoSteps.3.userHint: Almost ready! I finished my slides... (I need to review them once) de.
colleague-break.videoSteps.4.title: Lunch Offer (Social Communication)
colleague-break.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Don't stress, you will do great! Do you want to grab lunch together around one o'clock?
colleague-break.videoSteps.4.userHint: I would love to! Let's try that new taco place (I really want to, let's try the new taco place) de.
colleague-break.videoSteps.5.title: Contract & Return to Tables
colleague-break.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Awesome idea, tacos sound delicious! I will see you in the meeting room, have a great morning!
colleague-break.videoSteps.5.userHint: Sounds like a plan! See you at eleven (Agreed, see you at 11) diyerek vedalaş.

car-rental.description: Meet Ryan at Apex Car Rental, confirm your reservation, choose automatic transmission, learn about insurance details, and pick up the car key.
car-rental.situation: You go to the counter to pick up the car you reserved in advance at the airport car rental office.
car-rental.objectives.0.textTr: Confirm your reservation and car category.
car-rental.objectives.0.hint: Template: "Hello! Yes, I booked a compact car under my name."
car-rental.objectives.1.textTr: Specify automatic transmission and provide documents.
car-rental.objectives.1.hint: Template: "I would prefer an automatic car, please. Here is my driver's license."
car-rental.objectives.2.textTr: Check insurance coverage and fuel policy.
car-rental.objectives.2.hint: Template: "Does the insurance cover windshield damage? Understood, full tank on return."
car-rental.keyPhrases.0.tr: I would definitely prefer an automatic car, please.
car-rental.keyPhrases.1.tr: Does the insurance cover windshield damage?
car-rental.keyPhrases.2.tr: Where do I drop the car off?
car-rental.videoSteps.0.title: Welcoming at the Rental Office & Reservation
car-rental.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Hello! Welcome to Apex Car Rental. Do you have a reservation with us today?
car-rental.videoSteps.0.userHint: Hello! Yes, I booked a compact car under my name diyerek rezervasyonunu söyle.
car-rental.videoSteps.1.title: Transmission Preference: Automatic or Manual?
car-rental.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: Got it! We have both manual and automatic transmission available. Which do you prefer to drive?
car-rental.videoSteps.1.userHint: I would definitely prefer an automatic car, please (I prefer an automatic car) de.
car-rental.videoSteps.2.title: Driver's License & Credit Card Check
car-rental.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Automatic is ready for you! May I please see your driver's license and credit card for the deposit?
car-rental.videoSteps.2.userHint: Sure! Here is my driver's license and credit card diyerek belgelerini uzat.
car-rental.videoSteps.3.title: Insurance Coverage & Protection
car-rental.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: Everything looks valid. Would you like to add comprehensive insurance with zero excess for complete peace of mind?
car-rental.videoSteps.3.userHint: Yes, please. Does that insurance cover flat tires and windshields? diye sor.
car-rental.videoSteps.4.title: Fuel Policy (Full Tank Return)
car-rental.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Yes, it covers everything! Just remember our fuel policy is full-to-full, so please return the tank full.
car-rental.videoSteps.4.userHint: Understood! Where do I drop the car off? (Where do I return the car?) diye sor.
car-rental.videoSteps.5.title: Key Handover & Parking Stall No
car-rental.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Here are the keys! Your silver sedan is parked at Bay 42 in the garage. Drive safely!
car-rental.videoSteps.5.userHint: Bay 42, perfect! Thank you so much for your help and say goodbye.

fastfood-burger.description: Meet energetic cashier Alex at BurgerBite restaurant, order a burger menu, choose size, answer the 'for here or to go' question, and pay with a card.
fastfood-burger.situation: You order a burger menu at the counter for lunch at BurgerBite restaurant.
fastfood-burger.objectives.0.textTr: Order a burger meal with your preferred drink.
fastfood-burger.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "I would like a cheeseburger combo meal, please."
fastfood-burger.objectives.1.textTr: Choose your meal size and extras.
fastfood-burger.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "Medium size is great, thank you. Can I get ketchup?"
fastfood-burger.objectives.2.textTr: State whether your order is for here or to go.
fastfood-burger.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "For here, please. / To go, please."
fastfood-burger.keyPhrases.0.tr: I would like a cheeseburger combo meal, please.
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.0.title: Counter Greeting & Menu Order
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Hi there! Welcome to BurgerBite. What can I get started for you today?
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.0.userHint: Hello! I would like a cheeseburger meal, please and place your order.
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.1.title: Drink & Ketchup Request
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: Awesome choice! That comes with fries and a drink. What would you like to drink?
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.1.userHint: A regular cola, please. Can I get ketchup? and request your drink and ketchup.
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.2.title: Menu Size: Medium or Large?
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Sure thing, extra ketchup added! Would you like that meal in medium or large size?
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.2.userHint: Medium size is great, thank you and choose size.
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.3.title: For Here or To Go?
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: Perfect. Will you be eating here today, or is this order to go?
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.3.userHint: For here, please or To go, please say.
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.4.title: Total Amount & Payment
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Sounds good! Your total comes to nine dollars and fifty cents. Cash or card?
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.4.userHint: By credit card, please and extend your card.
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.5.title: Order Receipt & Number Delivery
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Payment approved! Here is your receipt and number twenty-four. We will call your number soon!
fastfood-burger.videoSteps.5.userHint: Thank you very much! Have a great day! and say thank you and wait.

supermarket-checkout.description: Meet Sam at FreshMart supermarket, find products in the aisles, learn the price of chocolate, ask for a bag at the checkout, and pay with a card.
supermarket-checkout.situation: You ask the staff for help while shopping at FreshMart supermarket and complete your payment at the checkout.
supermarket-checkout.objectives.0.textTr: Ask where an item is located politely.
supermarket-checkout.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "Excuse me, where is the milk, please?"
supermarket-checkout.objectives.1.textTr: Inquire about the price of an item.
supermarket-checkout.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "How much is this chocolate bar?"
supermarket-checkout.objectives.2.textTr: Choose your payment method at the checkout.
supermarket-checkout.keyPhrases.1.tr: How much is this chocolate bar?
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.0.title: Greeting & Asking About Products in the Aisle
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Hello! Welcome to FreshMart. Can I help you find something today?
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.0.userHint: Ask where the milk is by saying, "Hello! Excuse me, where is the milk?"
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.1.title: Giving Directions & Asking About Prices
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: The milk is in aisle three, next to the bakery. Do you need anything else?
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.1.userHint: Ask the price of the chocolate by saying, "Thank you! How much is this...?"
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.2.title: Price Information & Moving to the Checkout
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: That chocolate is two dollars and fifty cents. Are you ready to pay at the register?
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.2.userHint: Extend your basket to the checkout by saying, "Yes, I am ready."
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.3.title: Asking for a Bag at the Checkout
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: Great, that is four items in total. Would you like a shopping bag for these?
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.3.userHint: Ask for a bag by saying, "Yes, please. Can I have one bag?"
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.4.title: Payment Method: Cash or Card?
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Your total is twelve dollars. Will you pay with cash or credit card today?

supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.5.title: Receipt & Farewell
supermarket-checkout.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Payment approved! Here is your receipt and bag. Have a wonderful day!

street-directions.titleTr: Asking for Directions and Finding the Metro
street-directions.description: Meet Emma in the city center, ask for the nearest metro station, learn the walking distance, and get information about the ticket.
street-directions.situation: While wandering the streets of London, you ask Emma for the nearest metro station and get directions.
street-directions.objectives.0.textTr: Ask for directions to the nearest metro station.
street-directions.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "Excuse me, where is the nearest metro station?"
street-directions.objectives.1.textTr: Confirm walking distance and station name.
street-directions.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "Is it far from here? What is the name of the station?"
street-directions.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "Can I pay with credit card there?"
street-directions.keyPhrases.0.tr: Where is the nearest metro station?
street-directions.keyPhrases.2.tr: Can I pay with credit card there?
street-directions.videoSteps.0.title: Polite Stopping & Asking for the Metro
street-directions.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Excuse me? Oh, hello there! Can I help you with directions?
street-directions.videoSteps.0.userHint: Hello! Excuse me, where is the nearest metro station?
street-directions.videoSteps.1.title: Directions & Asking for Distance
street-directions.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: Sure! Walk straight for two blocks, then turn right at the traffic lights.
street-directions.videoSteps.1.userHint: Walk straight and turn right. Is it far? (Uzak mı?)
street-directions.videoSteps.2.title: Walking Time & Station Name
street-directions.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: No, it is very close! It only takes about five minutes on foot.
street-directions.videoSteps.2.userHint: That is great! What is the name of the station?
street-directions.videoSteps.3.title: Recognizing Signs & Tips
street-directions.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: It is called Central Station. Look for the big red and blue metro sign!
street-directions.videoSteps.3.userHint: Central Station, with a red and blue sign. Thank you!
street-directions.videoSteps.4.title: Ticket Purchase Information
street-directions.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: You are welcome! You can buy your ticket at the machine inside the entrance.
street-directions.videoSteps.4.userHint: Can I pay with credit card there? (Orada kartla ödeyebilir miyim?)
street-directions.videoSteps.5.title: Payment Confirmation & Safe Travels
street-directions.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Yes, cards and cash both work! Have a safe journey around the city!
street-directions.videoSteps.5.userHint: Thank you so much for your help! Have a wonderful day!

train-ticket.titleTr: Train Ticket Purchase and Platform Information
train-ticket.description: Meet Arthur at the ticket office of the big train station, ask for a round-trip ticket to the city you are going to, and learn the departure time and platform.
train-ticket.situation: You approach the ticket office to buy a ticket to Oxford at the London train station.
train-ticket.objectives.0.textTr: Request a round-trip ticket to your destination.
train-ticket.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "One ticket to Oxford, please. A round-trip return ticket, please."
train-ticket.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "Which platform does it leave from?"
train-ticket.objectives.2.textTr: Pay by card and ask about the ticket gate.
train-ticket.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "By credit card, please. Do I scan the ticket at the gate?"
train-ticket.keyPhrases.2.tr: Which platform does it depart from?
train-ticket.videoSteps.0.title: Welcoming at the Ticket Office & Destination
train-ticket.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Good morning! Welcome to the station. Where would you like to travel today?
train-ticket.videoSteps.0.userHint: Good morning! One ticket to Oxford, please.
train-ticket.videoSteps.1.title: One way or round trip?
train-ticket.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: Certainly! Would you like a single ticket or a round-trip return ticket?
train-ticket.videoSteps.2.title: Departure Time & Confirmation
train-ticket.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Great. The next train departs at ten-thirty. Does that time work for you?
train-ticket.videoSteps.3.title: Price & Payment Method
train-ticket.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: That will be eighteen pounds, please. How would you like to pay today?
train-ticket.videoSteps.4.title: Ticket Delivery & Platform Number
train-ticket.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Payment successful! Here is your ticket. Your train departs from platform four.
train-ticket.videoSteps.4.userHint: Platform four, thank you! Do I scan it at the gate?
train-ticket.videoSteps.5.title: Turnstile Information & Safe Travels
train-ticket.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Yes, just scan the barcode at the gate! Have a pleasant and safe journey!
train-ticket.videoSteps.5.userHint: Thank you so much for your help! Have a great day!

cafe-meetup.titleTr: Meeting at the Café and Ordering Coffee
cafe-meetup.description: Meet Mivo at the café, order your drink from the barista, and chat while sipping your coffee by the window.
cafe-meetup.situation: Mivo is waiting for you at the café entrance; you will order together from the barista and then go to the table.
cafe-meetup.objectives.0.textTr: Introduce yourself with your name and country.
cafe-meetup.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "Hello Mivo! My name is... and I am from Turkey."
cafe-meetup.objectives.1.textTr: Order a coffee or tea drink politely.
cafe-meetup.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "I would like a cappuccino, please."
cafe-meetup.objectives.2.textTr: Share your work and why you are learning English.
cafe-meetup.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "I am working as... and I want to travel."
cafe-meetup.keyPhrases.0.tr: I would like a cappuccino, please.
cafe-meetup.keyPhrases.1.tr: I am from Turkey, and I live in Istanbul.
cafe-meetup.keyPhrases.2.tr: I want to travel and speak English fluently.
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.0.title: Welcoming at the Entrance
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Hey! Over here! Welcome to the café! I am so happy to meet you. What is your name?
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.1.title: Barista Counter & Order
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: Let's get some drinks first! They have great coffee and tea here. What would you like to drink?
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.1.userHint: Place your order: 'I would like a cappuccino, please' or 'A cup of tea, please'.
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.2.title: Sitting at the Table & Coffees
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Mmm, this coffee smells delicious! Cheers! So, tell me, where are you from?
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.2.userHint: Cheers! (Şerefe) and use the phrase 'I am from Turkey'.
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.3.title: Chat at the Table
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: Turkey is an amazing country! And what do you do? Are you working, or are you a student?
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.3.userHint: I am working or I am a student.
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.4.title: Why English?
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: That is great! So, why are you learning English? Do you want to travel to other countries?
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.5.title: Departure & Farewell
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: You spoke English really well today! Thank you for the coffee. Let's meet again tomorrow! Have a great day!
cafe-meetup.videoSteps.5.userHint: Thank you Mivo! See you tomorrow, goodbye!

airport-travel.titleTr: Check-In and Flight at the Airport
airport-travel.description: Meet Mivo at the airport, check in your ticket and passport at the counter, drop off your luggage, and head to the boarding gate.
airport-travel.situation: Mivo greets you at the airport terminal, checks in your ticket at the counter, and you both head to the plane.
airport-travel.objectives.0.textTr: Check in at the desk with your ticket and documents.
airport-travel.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "Here is my ticket and travel document."
airport-travel.objectives.1.textTr: Weigh and drop off your check-in luggage.
airport-travel.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "I have one suitcase to check in."
airport-travel.objectives.2.textTr: State your seat preference (window vs. aisle).
airport-travel.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "I prefer a window seat, please."
airport-travel.keyPhrases.0.tr: Here is my ticket and travel document.
airport-travel.keyPhrases.1.tr: I have one suitcase to check in.
airport-travel.keyPhrases.2.tr: I prefer a window seat so I can see outside.
airport-travel.keyPhrases.3.tr: Have a safe flight and wonderful journey!
airport-travel.videoSteps.0.title: Arrival at the Airport & Information Screen
airport-travel.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Welcome to the airport! We have a flight to catch. Are you ready for check-in?
airport-travel.videoSteps.1.title: Check-In Desk & Documents
airport-travel.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: First, let's check in! Do you have your ticket and travel documents with you?
airport-travel.videoSteps.2.title: Baggage Weighing & Luggage Drop-Off
airport-travel.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Please put your suitcase on the luggage scale. How many bags are you checking in today?
airport-travel.videoSteps.3.title: Security Check & X-Ray Tray
airport-travel.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: We need to pass through security screening now. Please place your electronics in the plastic tray.
airport-travel.videoSteps.4.title: Gate Waiting Area & Seat Preference
airport-travel.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Our flight departs from Gate 14. Which seat do you prefer: window seat or aisle seat?
airport-travel.videoSteps.5.title: Boarding & Safe Flight
airport-travel.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Our flight is boarding now! You spoke great English at the airport. Have a wonderful flight and safe travels!
airport-travel.videoSteps.5.userHint: Thank you Mivo! Have a great journey (Sana da iyi yolculuklar) diyerek vedalaş.

neighbor-meetup.titleTr: Meeting the New Neighbor & Welcome Chat
neighbor-meetup.description: Meet your neighbor Mivo in the hallway of your new building, have a chat, listen to neighborhood suggestions, and accept the weekend tea invitation.
neighbor-meetup.situation: Mivo sees that you just moved in the hallway, approaches you with a welcome gift, and starts a warm introduction.
neighbor-meetup.objectives.0.textTr: Introduce yourself and confirm you moved in today.
neighbor-meetup.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "Hello! Yes, I just moved in today."
neighbor-meetup.objectives.1.textTr: State your apartment and floor number.
neighbor-meetup.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "I live on the second floor, in apartment 7."
neighbor-meetup.objectives.2.textTr: Ask for directions to the nearest supermarket or bakery.
neighbor-meetup.keyPhrases.0.tr: Nice to meet you, I just moved in today.
neighbor-meetup.keyPhrases.1.tr: I live on the second floor in apartment seven.
neighbor-meetup.keyPhrases.2.tr: Where is the nearest supermarket around here?
neighbor-meetup.keyPhrases.3.tr: Thank you for being so welcoming!
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.0.title: Encounter in the Hallway & Welcome
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Hello there! Welcome to the building! Did you just move in today?
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.0.userHint: Hello! Yes, I just moved in today (Evet bugün taşındım) diyerek kendini tanıt.
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.1.title: Name Introduction & Apartment Number
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: I am Yanki, and I live in apartment number 4. Which floor are you on?
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.1.userHint: Use the phrase I live on the second floor (İkinci katta oturuyorum).
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.2.title: Moving Boxes & Offer of Help
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Moving into a new home can be tiring! Do you need any help with your boxes?
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.2.userHint: Thank you so much, but I am almost finished (Neredeyse bitirdim) diyerek teşekkür et.
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.3.title: Neighborhood Guide & Supermarket
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: There is a fresh bakery and a great supermarket right around the corner. Would you like directions?
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.3.userHint: Ask about the location of the supermarket by saying That would be wonderful (Çok iyi olur).
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.4.title: Quiet Hours & Neighborhood Support
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Our apartment building is very quiet and friendly. If you ever need anything, just knock on my door!
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.4.userHint: Respond with the phrase That is very kind of you (Çok naziksiniz).
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.5.title: Weekend Tea Invitation & Farewell
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Good luck with unpacking! Let us have some tea together this weekend. Have a wonderful day!
neighbor-meetup.videoSteps.5.userHint: Sounds great! See you this weekend (Kulağa harika geliyor, hafta sonu görüşürüz) de.

hotel-checkin.description: Meet receptionist Oliver in the Grand Hotel lobby, confirm your reservation, specify your room preference, get Wi-Fi and breakfast information, and receive your room key.
hotel-checkin.situation: Oliver greets you at the Grand Hotel reception desk, completes the reservation process, and hands you the room key.
hotel-checkin.objectives.0.textTr: Confirm your reservation at the front desk.
hotel-checkin.objectives.0.hint: "Yes, I have a reservation under my name."
hotel-checkin.objectives.1.textTr: State your room preference (higher floor or garden view).
hotel-checkin.objectives.1.hint: "I would prefer a room on a higher floor, please."
hotel-checkin.objectives.2.textTr: Ask about breakfast times and location.
hotel-checkin.keyPhrases.0.tr: Yes, I have a reservation under my name.
hotel-checkin.keyPhrases.1.tr: Here is my booking confirmation and travel document.
hotel-checkin.keyPhrases.2.tr: I would prefer a room with a nice view.
hotel-checkin.keyPhrases.3.tr: We hope you enjoy your stay with us!
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.0.title: Reception Welcome & Reservation
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Good afternoon! Welcome to the Grand Hotel. Do you have a reservation with us?
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.0.userHint: Good afternoon! Yes, I have a reservation (Evet rezervasyonum var) diyerek başla.
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.1.title: Reservation Confirmation & Documents
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: Perfect! May I please see your booking confirmation and travel documents?
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.1.userHint: Sure, here is my booking confirmation (Elbette, işte rezervasyon onayım) kalıbını kullan.
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.2.title: Room Preference & Floor Selection
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Thank you. Would you prefer a room on a higher floor or closer to the garden?
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.2.userHint: I would prefer a room on a higher floor (Yüksek katta bir oda tercih ederim) de.
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.3.title: Breakfast & Wi-Fi Information
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: Breakfast is served every morning from seven to ten, and Wi-Fi is completely free.
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.3.userHint: That sounds great! Where is breakfast? (Kahvaltı nerede?) diyerek sor.
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.4.title: Room Key & Elevator Directions
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Here is your electronic room keycard for room 305. The elevators are just to your right.
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.4.userHint: Thank you very much! (Çok teşekkür ederim) diyerek anahtar kartını al.
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.5.title: Luggage Assistance & Enjoy Your Stay
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Our bellboy can help with your luggage. We hope you enjoy your stay with us!
hotel-checkin.videoSteps.5.userHint: Thank you for your help! (Yardımın için teşekkürler) diyerek iyi günler dile.

taxi-ride.description: Get into the iconic black taxi in London, talk to friendly driver Sam about where to go, get information about the route and traffic, enjoy the view of Big Ben, and pay the fare.
taxi-ride.situation: Sam greets you in the iconic black taxi on a rainy day in London, guiding you about the city as you head to the museum.
taxi-ride.objectives.0.textTr: Tell the driver your destination clearly.
taxi-ride.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "Could you please take me to the British Museum?"
taxi-ride.objectives.1.textTr: Ask how long the journey will take.
taxi-ride.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "How long will the ride take?"
taxi-ride.objectives.2.textTr: Pay the fare by contactless card and leave a tip.
taxi-ride.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "Here is my card, keep the change."
taxi-ride.keyPhrases.0.tr: Could you please take me to the British Museum?
taxi-ride.keyPhrases.1.tr: How long will the ride take?
taxi-ride.keyPhrases.2.tr: Look out your left window, you can see Big Ben!
taxi-ride.keyPhrases.3.tr: Here is my card, keep the change as a tip!
taxi-ride.videoSteps.0.title: Taxi Pickup & Destination
taxi-ride.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Hello there! Jump right in and make yourself comfortable. Where can I take you today?
taxi-ride.videoSteps.0.userHint: Hello! Could you take me to the British Museum? (Beni British Museum'a götürebilir misiniz?)
taxi-ride.videoSteps.1.title: Route Preference & Traffic Status
taxi-ride.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: The British Museum, brilliant! Traffic is a bit busy on Oxford Street, so I will take the scenic river route.
taxi-ride.videoSteps.1.userHint: That sounds wonderful! How long will it take? (Yolculuk ne kadar sürer?)
taxi-ride.videoSteps.2.title: City Symbols & Big Ben View
taxi-ride.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: It should take about fifteen minutes. Look out your left window, you can see Big Ben and the river Thames!
taxi-ride.videoSteps.3.title: Museum Recommendation & Ticket Information
taxi-ride.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: Are you visiting London for holiday? The museum has free entry, but remember to book an online timed ticket!
taxi-ride.videoSteps.3.userHint: Yes, I am on vacation! (Evet, tatildeyim!)
taxi-ride.videoSteps.4.title: Arrival at the Museum & Taxi Fare
taxi-ride.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: And here we are, right outside the main museum gates! The total fare is fourteen pounds, card or cash is fine.
taxi-ride.videoSteps.4.userHint: Here is my contactless card (İşte temassız kartım) and leave a tip.
taxi-ride.videoSteps.5.title: Payment Confirmation & Good Day Wish
taxi-ride.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Payment went through smoothly! Mind your step getting out, and enjoy your time in London!
taxi-ride.videoSteps.5.userHint: Thank you so much for the lovely ride! (Güzel yolculuk için çok teşekkürler!)

restaurant-dinner.description: Go to the table at Trattoria Bella, meet warm-hearted Italian chef Marco, order the seafood fettuccine special of the day, and enjoy a great evening with tiramisu and espresso.
restaurant-dinner.situation: Marco greets you with a warm smile at the entrance of Trattoria Bella, presents the menu, and suggests the special pasta of the day.
restaurant-dinner.objectives.0.textTr: Request a table politely for your dinner.
restaurant-dinner.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "Good evening! A table for one by the window, please."
restaurant-dinner.objectives.1.textTr: Order a drink and the chef's special fettuccine.
restaurant-dinner.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "The fettuccine sounds delicious! I will have that, please."
restaurant-dinner.objectives.2.textTr: Give feedback about the food and order dessert.
restaurant-dinner.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "Everything is delicious! I cannot resist tiramisu, please."
restaurant-dinner.keyPhrases.0.tr: Good evening! A table for one, please.
restaurant-dinner.keyPhrases.1.tr: I would like a glass of sparkling water with lemon.
restaurant-dinner.keyPhrases.2.tr: The fettuccine sounds delicious! I will have that.
restaurant-dinner.keyPhrases.3.tr: Everything is absolutely delicious, thank you!
restaurant-dinner.keyPhrases.4.tr: Can I pay with card? Keep the change as a tip!
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.0.title: Table Greeting & Menu Presentation
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Good evening! Welcome to Trattoria Bella. Table for one or two tonight?
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.0.userHint: Good evening! A table for one, please (Tek kişilik bir masa lütfen) diyerek başla.
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.1.title: Starter & Drink Order
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: Right this way! Can I start you off with some sparkling water or wine?
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.1.userHint: I would like a glass of sparkling water (Bir bardak maden suyu lütfen) kalıbını kullan.
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.2.title: Today's Special & Main Course Order
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Our chef's special tonight is handmade seafood fettuccine. What would you like for dinner?
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.2.userHint: The fettuccine sounds delicious! I will have that (Ondan alayım lütfen) de.
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.3.title: Meal Check & Taste Feedback
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: How is everything tasting tonight? Is the pasta cooked to your liking?
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.3.userHint: Everything is absolutely delicious! (Her şey son derece lezzetli!) diyerek teşekkür et.
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.4.title: Dessert & Espresso Suggestion
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Wonderful! Room for dessert? We have fresh homemade tiramisu and hot espresso.
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.4.userHint: One tiramisu and an espresso, please (Bir tiramisu ve bir espresso lütfen) diyerek sipariş ver.
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.5.title: Bill & Leaving a Tip
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Here is your bill! Take your time, whenever you are ready.
restaurant-dinner.videoSteps.5.userHint: Can I pay with card? (Kartla ödeyebilir miyim?) de ve bahşiş bırak.

doctor-visit.description: Meet Dr. Emma at the London clinic, describe your headache and sore throat symptoms, get examined, receive your prescription, and recover quickly.
doctor-visit.situation: Dr. Emma greets you with a smile in the bright examination room, asks you to sit down, listens to your complaints, and examines you.
doctor-visit.objectives.0.textTr: Explain your symptoms (headache and sore throat) clearly.
doctor-visit.objectives.0.hint: Phrase: "I have had a terrible headache and a sore throat since yesterday."
doctor-visit.objectives.1.textTr: Describe your fever and answer examination questions.
doctor-visit.objectives.1.hint: Phrase: "Yes, I felt feverish last night, my temperature was around 38 degrees."
doctor-visit.objectives.2.textTr: Ask about medication and thank the doctor for the advice.
doctor-visit.objectives.2.hint: Phrase: "How often should I use the spray? Thank you for your care, Dr. Emma!"
doctor-visit.keyPhrases.0.tr: I have had a terrible headache and a sore throat.
doctor-visit.keyPhrases.2.tr: Do I need to take any antibiotics for this?
doctor-visit.keyPhrases.3.tr: How often should I use the throat spray?
doctor-visit.keyPhrases.4.tr: Thank you so much for your care, doctor!
doctor-visit.videoSteps.0.title: Clinic Reception & Describing Symptoms
doctor-visit.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Good morning! Please take a seat. What brings you into the clinic today?
doctor-visit.videoSteps.0.userHint: Good morning doctor, I have a headache and sore throat (Başım ve boğazım ağrıyor) diyerek başla.
doctor-visit.videoSteps.1.title: Fever & Symptom Details
doctor-visit.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: I am sorry to hear that. Have you had any fever or chills alongside the throat pain?
doctor-visit.videoSteps.1.userHint: Yes, I had a mild fever last night (Evet dün gece ateşim vardı) diyerek yanıtla.
doctor-visit.videoSteps.2.title: Throat and Lung Examination
doctor-visit.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Let me take a quick look. Please open your mouth wide and say "Ah" for me.
doctor-visit.videoSteps.2.userHint: Ah... say "Does it look inflamed?" (İltihaplı görünüyor mu?)
doctor-visit.videoSteps.3.title: Diagnosis Explanation
doctor-visit.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: Your throat is slightly inflamed, but your lungs sound completely clear. It looks like a mild viral infection.
doctor-visit.videoSteps.3.userHint: That is a relief! (Bu bir rahatlama!) and ask if antibiotics are needed.
doctor-visit.videoSteps.4.title: Prescription & Medication Information
doctor-visit.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: No antibiotics needed. I will write a prescription for pain relief and a soothing throat spray.
doctor-visit.videoSteps.4.userHint: How often should I use the throat spray? (Boğaz spreyini günde kaç kez kullanmalıyım?)
doctor-visit.videoSteps.5.title: Recommendations & Prescription Delivery
doctor-visit.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Use it three times a day after meals, drink plenty of warm fluids, and get lots of rest!
doctor-visit.videoSteps.5.userHint: Thank you so much for your care, Dr. Emma! (İlginiz için teşekkürler!) goodbye.

job-interview.description: Participate in a job interview with HR Director Sarah at a prestigious company in London, share your experiences, strengths, and career goals, and successfully complete the interview.
job-interview.situation: Sarah greets you with a smile in her modern glass office in London Canary Wharf, reviews your CV, and asks friendly and professional questions to get to know you better.
job-interview.objectives.0.textTr: Introduce your professional background and current field clearly.
job-interview.objectives.0.hint: Template: "I have a background in technology and project coordination."
job-interview.objectives.1.textTr: Explain why you applied for this role and your key strengths.
job-interview.objectives.1.hint: Template: "My greatest strength is problem-solving and adapting quickly."
job-interview.objectives.2.textTr: Ask an insightful question about team collaboration.
job-interview.objectives.2.hint: Template: "Could you tell me more about how the team collaborates on projects?"
job-interview.keyPhrases.0.tr: I have a background in technology and digital projects.
job-interview.keyPhrases.1.tr: My greatest strength is problem-solving under tight deadlines.
job-interview.keyPhrases.2.tr: I admire your company culture and high-impact international vision.
job-interview.keyPhrases.3.tr: Could you tell me more about how the team collaborates?
job-interview.videoSteps.0.title: Greeting & Self-Introduction
job-interview.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Good morning! Thank you for coming in today. To get started, could you tell me a little bit about yourself?
job-interview.videoSteps.0.userHint: Good morning Sarah, I have a background in... summarize your professional background.
job-interview.videoSteps.1.title: Reason for Application & Motivation
job-interview.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: That is great experience! What made you interested in joining our company for this role?
job-interview.videoSteps.1.userHint: I admire your company culture... (Şirket kültürünüzü takdir ediyorum) use this phrase.
job-interview.videoSteps.2.title: Your Greatest Strength
job-interview.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: We value that passion! What would you consider your greatest professional strength?
job-interview.videoSteps.2.userHint: My greatest strength is problem-solving (En büyük gücüm problem çözmektir) respond with this phrase.
job-interview.videoSteps.3.title: Pressure and Time Management
job-interview.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: That is essential here. How do you usually handle tight deadlines or stressful situations?
job-interview.videoSteps.3.userHint: I prioritize tasks and communicate with the team (Görevleri önceliklendirir ve ekiple iletişim kurarım) too.
job-interview.videoSteps.4.title: Teamwork & Communication
job-interview.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: We value teamwork here. How do you like to collaborate with your team?
job-interview.videoSteps.5.title: Candidate's Question & Closing
job-interview.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: You have given wonderful answers! Before we wrap up, do you have any questions for me about the team?
job-interview.videoSteps.5.userHint: Could you tell me more about the team?

fitness-gym.titleTr: Training at the Gym & Fitness Coach
fitness-gym.description: Meet motivating coach Coach Leo in a modern gym, set your fitness goals, warm up and perform weight exercises with the correct form, and have an energetic workout.
fitness-gym.situation: Coach Leo welcomes you in a modern, bright, and energetic gym; asks about your goals, and guides you in warm-up and shoulder exercises.
fitness-gym.objectives.0.textTr: State your fitness goals (building strength and stamina).
fitness-gym.objectives.0.hint: "I want to build strength and improve my stamina."
fitness-gym.objectives.1.textTr: Ask about weights and warm-up duration.
fitness-gym.objectives.1.hint: "Should I start with three or five kilograms?"
fitness-gym.objectives.2.textTr: Confirm proper lifting form and thank your coach.
fitness-gym.objectives.2.hint: "Thank you so much, Coach Leo! See you next workout!"
fitness-gym.keyPhrases.0.tr: I want to build strength and improve my stamina.
fitness-gym.keyPhrases.1.tr: How many minutes should I warm up on the treadmill?
fitness-gym.keyPhrases.2.tr: Should I start with three or five kilograms?
fitness-gym.keyPhrases.3.tr: Thank you so much, Coach Leo! See you next workout!
fitness-gym.videoSteps.0.title: Welcome & Fitness Goals
fitness-gym.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Hey there! Welcome to the gym! What are your fitness goals for today?
fitness-gym.videoSteps.0.userHint: Hello Coach Leo! I want to build strength
fitness-gym.videoSteps.1.title: Warm-up & Treadmill
fitness-gym.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: Awesome! Let us start with a light warm-up on the treadmill.
fitness-gym.videoSteps.2.title: Weight Selection & Dumbbells
fitness-gym.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Just five minutes! Then we will grab some light dumbbells for shoulders.
fitness-gym.videoSteps.2.userHint: Should I start with three kilograms?
fitness-gym.videoSteps.3.title: Correct Form & Breath Control
fitness-gym.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: Start with three! Keep your back straight and breathe out as you lift.
fitness-gym.videoSteps.3.userHint: Like this? I can feel the burn!
fitness-gym.videoSteps.4.title: Water Break & Rest
fitness-gym.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Perfect form! Take a quick water break before our final set.
fitness-gym.videoSteps.5.title: Cool Down & High Five
fitness-gym.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Great job today! Let us do some quick stretches and high five!
fitness-gym.videoSteps.5.userHint: Thank you Coach Leo! See you next workout

clothing-boutique.titleTr: Shopping for Clothes in London Boutique
clothing-boutique.description: Meet fashion consultant Mia in a stylish boutique in London Soho, check out jacket and sweater models, choose size and color, try them on in the fitting room, and complete your shopping.
clothing-boutique.situation: Mia greets you with a warm smile in her modern stylish boutique in London Soho; she asks about the clothes you are looking for and guides you in size and color selection.
clothing-boutique.objectives.0.textTr: State what clothing item and size you are looking for.
clothing-boutique.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "I am looking for a warm jacket, and I usually wear medium."
clothing-boutique.objectives.1.textTr: Ask to try on the item in the fitting room.
clothing-boutique.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "Where are the fitting rooms? I will try it on right now."
clothing-boutique.objectives.2.textTr: Inquire about the price and discounts before paying.
clothing-boutique.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "How much is this jacket? That is a great deal!"
clothing-boutique.keyPhrases.0.tr: I am looking for a warm jacket or stylish sweater.
clothing-boutique.keyPhrases.1.tr: I usually wear medium size, and I prefer navy blue.
clothing-boutique.keyPhrases.2.tr: It fits me perfectly and feels very comfortable!
clothing-boutique.keyPhrases.3.tr: That is a great deal! I will take it, thank you.
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.0.title: Greeting & Asking What You Are Looking For
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Hello! Welcome to our boutique! Are you looking for anything special today?
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.0.userHint: Start by saying Hello! I am looking for a jacket.
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.1.title: Size & Color Preference
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: We have lovely new arrivals! What size and color do you prefer?
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.1.userHint: I wear medium, and I like navy blue.
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.2.title: Fitting Room
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: This navy jacket would look stunning on you! The fitting rooms are right there.
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.2.userHint: Thank you! I will try it on.
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.3.title: Getting Feedback in Front of the Mirror
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: That jacket looks amazing! It is one of our best designs.
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.3.userHint: It feels comfortable! How much is it?
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.4.title: Price & Discount
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: The total price is fifty pounds with our special discount today!
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.4.userHint: That is a great deal! I will take it.
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.5.title: Payment & Receipt Delivery
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: Here is your bag and receipt! Enjoy wearing your new jacket, goodbye!
clothing-boutique.videoSteps.5.userHint: Thank you for your help, Mia! Goodbye!

istanbul-tour.titleTr: Magical Istanbul City Tour & Cultural Journey
istanbul-tour.description: From the cool breeze of the Bosphorus to the historic stone streets of Galata, from the red nostalgic tram of Istiklal Street to the spice scents of the Grand Bazaar and the cute street cats, discover magical Istanbul in 8 steps in English.
istanbul-tour.situation: Ela greets you with a smile by the Bosphorus; she shares the spirit of Istanbul and its charming street cats in English at Galata, Istiklal, Grand Bazaar, Ortaköy, Sultanahmet, and Kadıköy Moda stops.
istanbul-tour.objectives.0.textTr: Describe the Bosphorus, seagulls, and historic ferry views.
istanbul-tour.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "The view of the Bosphorus and seagulls is incredible!"
istanbul-tour.objectives.1.textTr: Talk about Istanbul street cats and historic neighborhoods.
istanbul-tour.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "Istanbul cats are so adorable and friendly!"
istanbul-tour.objectives.2.textTr: Order Turkish tea by the sea and share your impressions.
istanbul-tour.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "Turkish tea in this tulip glass with the bridge view is wonderful!"
istanbul-tour.keyPhrases.0.tr: The view of the Bosphorus and seagulls is breathtaking.
istanbul-tour.keyPhrases.1.tr: Istanbul cats are so adorable and well cared for.
istanbul-tour.keyPhrases.2.tr: Turkish tea in a traditional tulip glass is wonderful.
istanbul-tour.keyPhrases.3.tr: Standing between these ancient historic monuments feels majestic.
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.0.title: Bosphorus & Ferry View
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.0.aiSpeechTr: Welcome to Istanbul! The view of the Bosphorus is breathtaking today!
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.0.userHint: Say, "It is incredible!" (İnanılmaz!) to express your admiration for the Bosphorus view.
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.1.title: Galata Tower & Street Cat
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.1.aiSpeechTr: Look at this friendly street cat resting near the historic Galata Tower!
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.1.userHint: Say, "Istanbul cats are adorable!" (İstanbul kedileri çok sevimli!) too.
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.2.title: Istiklal Street & Red Tram
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.2.aiSpeechTr: Here is Istiklal Street! Hear the bell of the nostalgic red tram?
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.2.userHint: Say, "Yes, it is so energetic!" (Evet, çok enerjik!) to praise the atmosphere of the street.
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.3.title: Grand Bazaar & Mosaic Lamps
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.3.aiSpeechTr: Welcome inside the Grand Bazaar! The colorful handmade lamps look magical!
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.3.userHint: Say, "The aromas of spices are fascinating!" (Baharat kokuları büyüleyici!) too.
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.4.title: Ortaköy & Bosphorus Tea Break
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.4.aiSpeechTr: Time for a tea break! Fresh Turkish tea by the sea is perfect.
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.4.userHint: Say, "Turkish tea with the bridge view is wonderful!" (Köprü manzaralı çay harika!) too.
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.5.title: Historic Sultanahmet Square
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.5.aiSpeechTr: We are at Sultanahmet! Centuries of history meet right here in this square.
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.5.userHint: Say, "Standing between historic monuments feels majestic!" (Tarihin ortasında durmak muhteşem!) too.
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.6.title: Kadıköy Moda Coast & Sunset
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.6.aiSpeechTr: We crossed to the Asian side! The sunset over Moda is breathtaking.
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.6.userHint: Say, "The sunset over the sea is unforgettable!" (Denizdeki gün batımı unutulmaz!) too.
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.7.title: Night Bosphorus Bridge Lights & Farewell
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.7.aiSpeechTr: What a memorable journey! Istanbul will always hold a piece of your heart!
istanbul-tour.videoSteps.7.userHint: Say, "Thank you so much, Ela!" (Çok teşekkürler Ela!) to say goodbye.

job-interview-tech.description: A deep interview simulation on architectural decisions, system design, and past experiences with a technical leader from a technology company based abroad.
job-interview-tech.situation: Alex greets you and asks you to explain the technical architecture of a large-scale project you worked on in the past and how you solved the bottlenecks you encountered.
job-interview-tech.objectives.0.textTr: Introduce your engineering background and recent tech stack concisely.
job-interview-tech.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "I have over X years of experience primarily working with..."
job-interview-tech.objectives.1.textTr: Explain a tough technical challenge and how you solved it.
job-interview-tech.objectives.1.hint: STAR Technique: Use the order of Situation, Task, Action, Result.
job-interview-tech.objectives.2.textTr: Ask a thoughtful question about the company’s engineering culture.
job-interview-tech.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "Could you tell me more about how your team approaches code review and deployment cycles?"
job-interview-tech.keyPhrases.0.tr: We decided to decouple the services to improve fault tolerance.
job-interview-tech.keyPhrases.1.tr: The main bottleneck was database connection pooling under peak traffic.
job-interview-tech.keyPhrases.2.tr: In retrospect, choosing an event-driven architecture saved considerable latency.

b2b-product-pitch.description: Explain the ROI (Return on Investment) value of your SaaS product to the Purchasing Director of a large corporate client and manage objections.
b2b-product-pitch.situation: Eleanor knows that her current systems are expensive, but she is worried about the risks of a new transition.
b2b-product-pitch.objectives.0.textTr: Highlight the core value proposition and efficiency gains of your platform.
b2b-product-pitch.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "Our solution seamlessly integrates with your stack, reducing operational overhead by 30%."
b2b-product-pitch.objectives.1.textTr: Address the budget and onboarding timeframe concerns confidently.
b2b-product-pitch.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "We provide a dedicated onboarding specialist and guarantee zero downtime migration."
b2b-product-pitch.objectives.2.textTr: Propose a 14-day proof of concept (PoC) pilot.
b2b-product-pitch.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "How about we initiate a 2-week pilot with your core team so you can validate the metrics yourself?"
b2b-product-pitch.keyPhrases.0.tr: Our clients typically see a 40% reduction in customer turnaround time.
b2b-product-pitch.keyPhrases.1.tr: Security compliance is built directly into our core infrastructure.

airport-transit-trouble.titleTr: Missing Connection Flight at the Airport
airport-transit-trouble.description: You missed your connecting flight at London Heathrow Airport because your first flight was delayed. Speak with the airline representative to request a new ticket and hotel.
airport-transit-trouble.situation: David is trying to manage a long queue due to bad weather. You should assert your rights politely but firmly.
airport-transit-trouble.objectives.0.textTr: Explain that your incoming flight was delayed by 2 hours.
airport-transit-trouble.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "My previous flight was delayed, which caused me to miss my connection to New York."
airport-transit-trouble.objectives.1.textTr: Request to be booked on the next available direct flight.
airport-transit-trouble.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "Could you please rebook me onto the next available flight today?"
airport-transit-trouble.objectives.2.textTr: Ask for a hotel voucher or meal allowance if the flight is tomorrow.
airport-transit-trouble.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "Since the flight is tomorrow morning, does the airline provide complimentary accommodation?"
airport-transit-trouble.keyPhrases.0.tr: Here is my boarding pass and baggage tag number.
airport-transit-trouble.keyPhrases.1.tr: Is there any direct flight departing later this evening?

coffee-shop-smalltalk.description: Order a special coffee at a popular café in London Soho, make milk and syrup choices, and have a warm chat with the barista.
coffee-shop-smalltalk.situation: Chloe asks you how your day was and suggests your favorite coffee beans.
coffee-shop-smalltalk.objectives.0.textTr: Order a customized coffee drink with specific milk and size.
coffee-shop-smalltalk.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "Could I have a medium oat flat white with extra shot, please?"
coffee-shop-smalltalk.objectives.1.textTr: Ask about a bakery item in the glass display.
coffee-shop-smalltalk.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "Are the almond croissants freshly baked this morning?"
coffee-shop-smalltalk.objectives.2.textTr: Pay via contactless card and exchange polite pleasantries.
coffee-shop-smalltalk.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "I will pay with card contactless. Have a wonderful rest of your day!"
coffee-shop-smalltalk.keyPhrases.0.tr: Could I get that to go, please?

visa-embassy-interview.description: Interview with the consular officer for U.S. B1/B2 tourist and business visa. Prove your purpose of visit, travel plans, and ties to your country.
visa-embassy-interview.situation: Bradley is a serious, official officer who expects clear, direct, and confident answers to questions.
visa-embassy-interview.objectives.0.textTr: State the exact primary purpose and planned duration of your trip.
visa-embassy-interview.objectives.0.hint: Pattern: "I am traveling to attend the annual TechCon conference in San Francisco for 8 days."
visa-embassy-interview.objectives.1.textTr: Explain your current job, employer, and economic ties to your home country.
visa-embassy-interview.objectives.1.hint: Pattern: "I work as a Lead Engineer at XYZ for 3 years, and I will resume my duties immediately after the trip."
visa-embassy-interview.objectives.2.textTr: Clarify who is covering the flight and hotel expenses.
visa-embassy-interview.objectives.2.hint: Pattern: "My employer is fully sponsoring the travel and accommodation costs."
visa-embassy-interview.keyPhrases.0.tr: Here is my official conference invitation letter.
visa-embassy-interview.keyPhrases.1.tr: I have strong family and professional ties in my home country.
